dslRule:
<!id: increase-content-assist-min-size>
<!description: Increase minimum size values (30 to 50) for content assist popup in ContentAssistant.java to ensure better visibility for long API names.>
<!severity: HINT>
java.lang.Math.max($value, 30) :: inClass("org.eclipse.jface.text.contentassist.ContentAssistant")
=> java.lang.Math.max($value, 50)
;;
summary: Update the hardcoded minimum size (from 30 to 50) when calling Math.max for UI component dimensions within the ContentAssistant class.
